Class Times & Registration

Everything you need to know about enrolling your child at Monkey Tree.

👶 Who Can Enroll?

We accept children from ages 2½ (as long as they turn 3 by the end of the calendar year) to 5 years old.

📋 How to Register

In order to register, please contact the school by email or by phone. We will schedule an appointment for you and your child to come and visit the school, meet the teachers, and answer any questions you may have.

💰 Classes & Pricing

Class Days Hours Monthly Fee
Morning Class Monday – Friday 8:30 a.m. – 11:30 a.m. $595/month
Afternoon Class Monday – Friday 12:30 p.m. – 3:30 p.m. $595/month

⚠️ All classes require a $100 non-refundable registration fee payable at the time of enrollment.

🎉 Government Subsidy Available

We are thrilled to share that Monkey Tree Montessori is approved for the government funding program, Child Care Fee Reduction Initiative (CCFRI), which reduces the monthly fee from $595 to $500.

Ask us about eligibility and how to apply when you contact us.

📞 Ready to Register?

Contact us today to schedule your visit and get your child started on their Montessori journey.
